accountBinding: Upload practice media through the normal authenticated Studio entry. The starter is fresh and belongs to that account. This recipe transfers no owner, Storage path, cloud allowance or completed render.

steps.title: Choose the source
steps.why: This original screen recording shows a real conversion. Do not upload learner names, passwords or API keys.

steps.title: Open the editor
steps.value: Click once the uploaded source is ready
steps.why: The preview is the programme monitor; the timeline determines what will be in the export.

steps.title: Preserve the whole screen
steps.why: A portrait crop can hide code or its output. A screen demonstration needs both readable.

steps.title: Review the source
steps.why: Check that you can read the number, the Convert action and the eight-bit result.

steps.title: Name and save
steps.why: Save retains editable decisions. Downloading a movie will not replace your editable backup.

steps.title: Choose a viewing format
steps.why: These match the lesson delivery. Higher resolution increases detail and file size; it does not correct an inaccurate explanation.
